name: water elemental
desc: Water Elemental is a CR 5 elemental.

actions.name: freeze
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes Cold damage, its Speed decreases by 20 feet until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: water form
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

actions.name: slam
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone] condition.

actions.name: whelm
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=TQchFj2VXXJgU7Lq]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=TQchFj2VXXJgU7Lq]] in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space. Failure: [[/damage average activity=TQchFj2VXXJgU7Lq]] damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Until the grapple ends, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition, is &Reference[suffocating]{suffocating} unless it can breathe water, and takes [[/damage average activity=khxVwH3AB0sx1qRG]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a [[/check ath dc=@skills.ath.passive format=long]]. Success: Half damage only.
